messages:
leah_sales: quick sync after call — Swivel wants an API drop-in POC to validate parity and perf. listing open items.

omar_se: need canonical request/response samples and their conversation semantics. can someone paste?

leah_sales: their sample: POST /v1/generate {"model":"swivel-2x", "prompt":"Summarize:", "conversation_id":"sess_1" } -> response.outputs[0].text. they keep session server-side.

omar_se: diffs to validate: envelope (outputs vs choices.message), streaming cadence, tool_call shape (ordered args), tokenizer offsets.

simon_infra: perf note: they expect p99 < 350ms @512 tokens. Swivel pins session cache to instance; for parity we can run Dedicated pinned cache but must size memory. I'll sketch infra plan.

nina_security: enterprise checklist: VPC peering, BYOK/KMS, audit log retention 1y, IP allowlist, EU data residency. legal will ask about non-prod retention and cache opt-out.

ray_customer: confirm we can opt-out of caching per request and rotate JWKs without downtime. HSM support?

omar_se: quick mitigation: provide a small compatibility shim that maps our choices->outputs and normalizes tool_calls to ordered args. prototype will log added latency. also running tokenizer diff harness on their 50 prompts.

leah_sales: procurement Qs: committed discount mapping to Dedicated? billing for prefix cache tokens? need a TCO for 100M gen tokens + 10M embeddings/month.

simon_infra: Dedicated uses reserved pricing separate from hosted credits. prefix cache not billed as tokens but impacts compute/cost modeling. will include cost delta in runbook.

dev-bot: POC workspace created: rg-poc-swivel-2026, creds shared.

omar_se: action items: parity eval + tokenizer report (Tue EOD). simon: infra runbook + perf numbers (Tue EOD). nina: security packet + HSM/KMS confirmation (Wed). leah: commercial draft for caching/data terms (Wed).

ray_customer: thanks team, SOC2/pentest timing is main blocker for legal. we'll await metrics before scheduling contract call.
